reader.decision: Approve the allowlist in plugin_env, conditional on a quick check that no third-party plugins in /srv/tinkerbox/plugins need other variables. Rotate BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET and SENTRY_DSN as well if they were exposed.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows the root cause is inheriting the whole environment, and my two-name denylist would still leak BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET. The allowlist fixes that, and the only stated risk is outside plugins breaking, which I can check before shipping.

reconstruction.problem: plugin_env copies the whole runner environment and pops only three named secrets (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DATABASE_URL, GITHUB_TOKEN). STRIPE_API_KEY, added to deploy/runner.env on 2 October, reached feed-fetch, whose debug path prints dict(os.environ) to stderr (main.py:14). A customer pasted that into a public ticket on 24 October (INC-57).
reconstruction.what_breaks: Any secret added later reaches every plugin. My two-name denylist would still leave BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET exposed through the same path. The key was rotated on 24 October.
reconstruction.fix: In runner/spawn.py, delete DENYLIST and the pop loop. Add ALLOWED = {PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY}. plugin_env returns only variables in ALLOWED or starting with TINKERBOX_. Keep the TINKERBOX_PLUGIN_DIR assignment. No change to feed-fetch.
reconstruction.cost: A plugin that needs any other variable fails until it is added to ALLOWED. The three in-repo plugins were checked and are fine. Plugins outside the repo were not checked.

follow_up_questions: Do any third-party plugins in /srv/tinkerbox/plugins rely on environment variables outside PATH, HOME, LANG, HTTPS_PROXY and TINKERBOX_*?
Were SENTRY_DSN and BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET exposed in the public ticket, and have they been rotated? The message says only that the key was rotated.
reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve the allowlist in plugin_env. Before it ships, I want the plugins in /srv/tinkerbox/plugins checked for other variables they need. If any need one, add that variable to ALLOWED rather than going back to the denylist. I also want BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET and SENTRY_DSN rotated if the ticket exposed them.
